projectDescription: A collection of modular, independently-installable C# NuGet libraries powering the Prowl game engine — covering math, rendering, UI, physics, networking, serialization, and more.
keyFeatures: 23 independently-installable Prowl.* NuGet packages under a single version
Prowl.Vector — comprehensive 32/64-bit math with vectors, matrices, quaternions, noise, CSG, and BVH
Prowl.Graphite — low-level Vulkan/D3D11 GPU abstraction with declarative render graph
Prowl.Quill — hardware-accelerated anti-aliased 2D vector graphics canvas with SVG support
Prowl.Paper — immediate-mode UI framework with animations, transitions, and event bubbling
Prowl.Origami — full immediate-mode widget library with charts, docking, and 3D gizmos
Prowl.Echo — high-performance serializer with source generation beating System.Text.Json
Prowl.Clay — pure-C# 3D model importer for glTF 2.0, FBX, and OBJ with post-process pipeline
Prowl.Wicked — IL-weaved authoritative networking with RPCs, SyncVars, and TCP transport
Prowl.Drift — 2D rigid body physics with SAT collision and 8 joint types
Prowl.Aperture — dependency-free image loader supporting 14 formats
Prowl.Ember — live hot-reload migration of object graphs including closures and cycles
Prowl.Recast — navmesh generation and pathfinding (DotRecast port)
Prowl.Photonic — CPU path-traced lightmap baker with BVH4/AVX2 acceleration
Prowl.Scribe — TrueType font parser, layout engine, rich text, and Markdown renderer
Prowl.Rosetta — localization with CLDR plurals, gender forms, and layered providers
Prowl.Slang — managed .NET bindings for the Slang shader compiler
Prowl.Crumb — zero-allocation span-based tokenizer/lexer engine
Prowl.Scaffold — allocation-free incremental UI layout engine
Prowl.Unwrapper — mesh UV unwrapper (Projection and Conformal/LSCM modes)
